# Wrecked Metal v0.1 — First public beta

This is the first public build of **Wrecked Metal**, a native Android port of a classic N64 demolition racer, rebuilt from the community decompilation and compiled straight to ARM. No emulator: the game's own code, running on your phone, drawn through Vulkan.

It is a beta. It runs a full race at a steady 60 fps on my test device, but it has only been tested on a handful of phones so far, and that is exactly where you come in.

> **You need your own ROM.** This release contains no ROM and no game assets. See [The ROM](#the-rom) below.

## What's in v0.1

### Two ways to play
- **PLAY WRECKED METAL**: the enhanced game, with every improvement below.
- **Play Fidelity**: the game as it was on the N64, with the original HUD and filtering, 22 kHz audio and the N64 controller layout.

Each mode has its own settings; your save is shared.

### Graphics and performance
- Native ARM build on SDL3, Fast3D renderer on SDL_gpu / Vulkan
- Steady 60 fps with vsync (Galaxy S23 Ultra)
- 720p / 1080p, 2x MSAA, anisotropic filtering
- Widescreen 3D and draw distance up to 16x

### Audio
- 44.1 kHz output
- Replace any track with your own `.ogg` or `.mp3`
- Audio comes back by itself after calls and interruptions

### Controls
- Touch overlay with a floating analog stick or arrows; slide between buttons
- Bluetooth and USB gamepads out of the box, with analog gas and brake on the triggers and camera on the right stick
- Adaptive haptics and rumble

### In-game
- Native options menus with "restore defaults"
- Cheats page for the game's built-in codes

No telemetry, no ads, no account. The app asks for no internet permission at all.

## Install

1. Download the APK below.
2. Open it on your device and allow installing from unknown sources if asked.
3. Launch **Wrecked Metal**, tap **Pick ROM** and select your own copy of the game.
4. Tap **PLAY WRECKED METAL** or **Play Fidelity**.

**Requirements:** Android 10+, Vulkan, and a device that can run **32-bit apps**. This build is `armeabi-v7a`. Some recent phones (Pixel 7 and newer, for example) are 64-bit only and cannot install it yet. The native `arm64-v8a` build is the next big milestone.

## The ROM

You need your own copy of **Destruction Derby 64 (USA)** in `.z64`, `.n64` or `.v64` format. The app checks it by SHA1 (`a2c0799e13566d1b723299592cfcac9387f25fa7` for `.z64`), converts it if needed and keeps it in its private storage. It never leaves your device. Please don't ask for ROMs in issues.

## Known limitations

- 32-bit only for now; 64-bit is in progress
- Tested mainly on a Galaxy S23 Ultra (Snapdragon 8 Gen 2); other GPUs may show issues
- The Windows build compiles but is untested

## Help me test

If something breaks, open an [issue](https://github.com/dedecidao/Wrecked-Metal/issues) with your phone model, Android version and the log at `Android/data/com.costelinhagames.wreckedmetal/files/Data/Logs/dd64.log`. If it runs well, tell me that too in [Discussions](https://github.com/dedecidao/Wrecked-Metal/discussions); a "works on my Retroid / Odin / Galaxy" report is genuinely useful.
